notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Insects.
description:
Activate Tymora's Invoker by paying {8}, causing you to draw two cards.
The Locust God triggers twice, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens with flying and haste.
The Insects enter the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes, adding {C}{C} for each Insect you control.
Repeat.
